articles.title: Women's Super League: Injured Arsenal star Mariona Caldentey out for up to 10 weeks
articles.summary: Arsenal midfielder Mariona Caldentey is set to miss about two months of Women's Super League action because of a hamstring injury.
articles.body:
Arsenal midfielder Mariona Caldentey is expected to miss about two months of Women's Super League action because of a hamstring injury.

The Spain international suffered the injury during Arsenal's 4-2 defeat at Manchester City on 4 October.

Caldentey has been a key player for Arsenal since joining from Barcelona two years ago and was the 2024-25 WSL Player of the Year.

"Mariona [Caldentey] went off against Manchester City and didn't go away with Spain. It's a hamstring injury so she will be out for a while," said Arsenal manager Renee Slegers.

"It's a bigger hamstring injury. The estimation right now is between eight to 10 weeks. We'll see.

"We're re-scanning and the healing process looks good. Of course, we're hoping for less [time out], but it's a bigger hamstring injury."

Caldentey's absence is a blow to Arsenal who return to WSL action on Saturday when they host Birmingham City (12:45 BST).

The Gunners have had a disappointing start to their campaign, winning just one of their opening five WSL matches, leading to questions over Slegers' position.

They sit 10th in the table and will be without injured England forward Chloe Kelly and German summer signing Selina Cerci on Saturday.

"Selina had surgery on her knee. She had been struggling and it got worse, so we had to intervene unfortunately," said Slegers.

"She's out as well for a while. It's one of the reasons why it was harder for Selina to get into the team because she missed some parts of pre-season.

"She has been available and has trained the majority of sessions, but of course it affects the player when you're managing something.

"Germany did a scan and the best solution going forward was to clean [the knee] up with surgery."

articles.title: La FIFA frena el plan de venta del Mundial: Infantino pide perdón en una reunión tensa
articles.standfirst: El presidente de FIFA tampoco dio detalles sobre el caso de la tarjeta roja a Folarin Balogun que no acarreó partido de sanción tras una llamada de Donald Trump
articles.summary: El presidente de FIFA tampoco dio detalles sobre el caso de la tarjeta roja a Folarin Balogun que no acarreó partido de sanción tras una llamada de Donald Trump
articles.body: Gianni Infantino ofreció una disculpa a sus más feroces críticos, pero no aportó nuevos detalles ni documentos sobre los asuntos de la FIFA que más les preocupan, en una tensa reunión de su consejo rector realizada el jueves. No hubo documentos sobre el plan de venta del Mundial por 4.200 millones de dólares que lanzó y luego abandonó en julio. Tampoco se dieron detalles sobre el caso de la tarjeta roja a Folarin Balogun en el Mundial y sobre cómo el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, intervino para ayudar al delantero de la selección anfitriona. Sin embargo, la FIFA se replanteará si debe seguir otorgando el premio de la paz que se creó para entregárselo a Trump el pasado diciembre. Debbie Hewitt, vicepresidenta de la FIFA, contó tras la reunión de tres horas y media que, presionado por dirigentes del fútbol europeo para que presentara pruebas por escrito sobre su hermético plan de capital privado para el Mundial, algo que provocó una fractura global, Infantino les pidió que presentaran preguntas por escrito. "El hombre tiene que responder a esas preguntas. Si no responde a esas preguntas, no, no es apto para ser presidente de la FIFA", Hewitt, quien preside la Asociación Inglesa de Fútbol. La UEFA, el ente rector del fútbol europeo, encabeza los intentos de apartar a Infantino antes de las elecciones presidenciales de la FIFA en marzo o durante ellas, y el jueves escuchó muy poco que cambiara esa postura. "No se proporcionaron respuestas satisfactorias", manifestó el dirigente del fútbol alemán Bernd Neuendorf, uno de los ocho delegados de la UEFA en el Consejo de la FIFA, de 37 miembros, que preside Infantino. El Consejo no se había reunido desde que Infantino provocó la crisis. "Necesitamos a una persona íntegra, alguien de quien se pueda esperar que restaure la reputación de la asociación, que sin duda se ha perdido", dijo Neuendorf a los periodistas. Infantino sí comenzó la reunión pidiendo disculpas a sus colegas del Consejo por haberlos tomado por sorpresa y por haber generado un revuelo con su plan de inversores privados junto a Joshua Kushner, que se reveló en informes de prensa nueve días después de la final del Mundial en julio. La UEFA también ha solicitado a tribunales en Estados Unidos el derecho a obtener pruebas para una denuncia penal contra Infantino en Suiza. Los escritos judiciales alegan una posible mala gestión de las finanzas de la FIFA en la valoración que asignó a la filial prevista que gestionaría los derechos comerciales del torneo. Esa filial iba a ser propiedad, al menos en un 20%, de inversores encabezados por Joshua Kushner, hermano de Jared Kushner, yerno de Trump.

articles.title: Pubill, de ser rechazado por bajito... a volver como campeón Mundial
articles.standfirst: De niño le echaron de la cantera del Espanyol por no dar el estirón. Regresa en su mejor momento y con la estrella de campeón del mundo
articles.summary: De niño le echaron de la cantera del Espanyol por no dar el estirón. Regresa en su mejor momento y con la estrella de campeón del mundo
articles.body: Por bajito y por su técnica de carrera. Estos fueron los dos motivos por los que Marc Pubill no pudo seguir en la cantera del Espanyol, donde permaneció entre 2011 y 2017, pero donde no pudo triunfar por dos motivos que ahora resultan, a todas luces, sorprendentes. Su salida de la cantera perica le llevó al Gimnastic de Manresa, donde siguió su formación hasta que el Levante le vio las condiciones adecuadas para llegar a la élite. El resto ya está más que sabido, pasó al Almería, oro olímpico y una llegada fugaz al Atlético que le cambió la vida. Porque fue de rojiblanco, con Simeone como jefe, donde el catalán irrumpió el curso pasado de central. Abandonó el puesto de lateral derecho para el que fue fichado y firmó una temporada de tanto nivel que De La Fuente se lo llevó al Mundial. Allí ganó la segunda estrella y con ella en el pecho regresa al que fue su equipo de niño. Y así el que reconoció que su sueño era “ser soldado del Cholo” vuelve a medirse a un Espanyol que le rechazó por ser bajito y que seguramente se arrepiente de no poder tener en sus filas a este defensa de 1,90 que se ha convertido en uno de los predilectos de la afición del Atlético. Ahora, además, recuperando su origen de lateral derecho. Ante el United salió en el segundo acto para jugar ahí, como también lo hizo con la selección en el último parón. En ambos puestos es, sin duda, una de las realidades jóvenes más importantes de nuestro fútbol, aunque en el Espanyol no lo vieran hace menos de una década.

articles.summary: El de Quilmes va camino del mes de baja
articles.body: El Málaga CF apura su preparación para la visita de la Real Sociedad a La Rosaleda este domingo. El equipo blanquiazul completó este jueves una nueva sesión de trabajo en la Ciudad Deportiva Fundación MCF, aunque con una ausencia que se mantiene: Juan Cruz continúa sin ejercitarse junto al resto de sus compañeros. El atacante sigue recuperándose de la recaída que sufrió en su lesión muscular en el bíceps femoral de la pierna derecha. A tres días del encuentro, el futbolista continúa realizando trabajo específico y su evolución durante las próximas horas será determinante para conocer sus opciones de llegar a tiempo al duelo ante el conjunto donostiarra. Juan Cruz no fue el único jugador que trabajó al margen. Murillo, Aaron Ochoa y Julen Lobete también continúan con sus respectivos procesos de recuperación y realizaron trabajo específico en las instalaciones de La Rosaleda. Los cuatro jugadores permanecen, por tanto, fuera de la dinámica normal del grupo. La sesión arrancó poco antes de las 10:30 horas con una primera fase de activación en el gimnasio. Posteriormente, la plantilla se trasladó al césped de la denominada 'pradera', donde completó el calentamiento antes de centrarse en diferentes ejercicios tácticos y estratégicos pensando ya en el partido del domingo. El Málaga todavía tendrá dos entrenamientos antes de enfrentarse a la Real Sociedad. El primero será este viernes, a partir de las 10:30 horas, nuevamente en la Ciudad Deportiva Fundación MCF. Será una sesión especialmente importante para comprobar la evolución de los futbolistas que arrastran problemas físicos y, en especial, de un Juan Cruz que continúa trabajando contrarreloj.

articles.title: Reports: Harry Kane close to renewing Bayern contract until 2029
articles.summary: Star striker Harry Kane is close to renewing his Bayern Munich contract by two years until 2029, British and German news reports said on Thursday. Sky Sports...
articles.body:
Star striker Harry Kane is close to renewing his Bayern Munich contract by two years until 2029, British and German news reports said on Thursday.

Sky Sports UK said that "a new deal in principle" has been agreed upon by the England captain and the Bundesliga champions and that Bayern "are now finalising the paperwork on his contract extension."

Germany's Bild paper said that the contract is expected to be signed within the next 10 days.

Bayern president Herbert Hainer said last weekend that he was "very optimistic" as talks were going extremely well. Kane has also suggested that the talks, in which he is represented by his father and his brother, were in their final stages.

Kane, 33, came to Bayern in 2023 from Tottenham Hotspur for €100 million ($111.7 million) on a four-year contract until 2027.

He has scored 154 goals in 156 matches across all competitions, plus 35 assists. He was Bundesliga top scorer the past three seasons and has also scored in his last nine Champions League matches.

Kane won the first titles of his career at Bayern, the Bundesliga in 2025 and a Bundesliga and German Cup double last season.

articles.title: Vinícius Jr. responds to boos from Real Madrid fans
articles.summary: Real Madrid star Vinícius Jr. has responded to the latest negative reception afforded to him by the club’s supporters on Wednesday.Wide-man Vinícius for his...
articles.body:
Real Madrid star Vinícius Jr. has responded to the latest negative reception afforded to him by the club's supporters on Wednesday.

Wide-man Vinícius for his part featured from the off yesterday evening, as Real Madrid kicked their continental campaign back into gear in a Champions League meeting with AS Roma.

When all was said and done, Los Blancos enjoyed an outing to remember, recovering from two goals down courtesy of a last-gasp 'Remontada' at the Stadio Olimpico.

Vinícius, however, played no part in the comeback. Amid another underwhelming individual showing in Italy's capital – including a direct mistake for one of Roma's goals – the 26-year-old was hauled off before the hour mark.

Vinícius' woes did not go at all unnoticed on the part of the travelling Real Madrid supporters in attendance at the clash, with the Brazilian having been targeted with boos and whistles on a number of occasions on Wednesday.

Speaking to the media post-match, 'Viní' was himself therefore drawn on the reception afforded to him by the Blancos faithful. And the attacker was honest in his response, admitting:

"The whistles from the fans do not help me; I'd rather they supported me… but I understand, they pay for tickets. I'd rather they boo me than the youngsters."

articles.title: NAIA school suspends 6 players following alleged locker room assault as part of an 'accountability arrangement' for players being late to practice
articles.summary: Two Central Methodist players have been charged with third-degree assault for their roles in the alleged altercation.
articles.body:
Two players at NAIA school Central Methodist have been suspended after their arrest on third-degree assault charges for their role in an alleged fight club among players on the football team.

The school has suspended six players in total after a player was allegedly forced to go to urgent care after he was late for practice and was allegedly assaulted by teammates Kamarrion Ferguson and Michael Hourel on Oct. 9.

According to the probable cause statement, the alleged victim told an officer from the Fayette Police Department (Missouri) that the team had a rule in place that a player who was late for practice had to fight a teammate as punishment.

"[Victim] continued by telling me on Friday, October 9, 2026, at approximately 0730 hours he was in the locker room to engage in a mutual fight with fellow football player for being late," the statement said. "The fellow football player, identified as Witness 1 did not want to engage in the fight other than do 'body shots.' [Victim] explained that an individual identified as Michael Hourel stated 'nah, f*** that' and struck [Victim] in the face. [Victim] explained that he fought back in self-defense."

According to the statement, others joined in and Ferguson was identified as another alleged assailant. When confronted by police about the incident, Hourel allegedly admitted to taking part in the incident but that he had only hit his teammate with an open hand before others joined in.

The victim told police that he went to urgent care the following day and had been referred to a concussion specialist "due to the possibility of a brain bleed."

"Hourel began to tell me that he was the captain of the football team and the defensive players for the team had issues with not being held accountable for being late to walk through and practices," the statement said. "Hourel had a meeting with the team, and the team including [Victim] agreed to fight if the rule was not followed. Hourel further explained [Victim] failed to show up on time on October 9, 2026. Hourel mentioned that in the locker room [Victim] had chosen a wide receiver identified as Witness 1 to fight. Hourel did not feel that the fight with Witness 1 was going to teach [Victim] a lesson, so Hourel fought [Victim]."

The four other players who have been suspended from the team but not charged with a crime have not been named by the school, and a university investigation is underway.

"The safety and well-being of this student is our highest priority," the school said in a statement about the player who was allegedly assaulted. "This behavior is unacceptable and inconsistent with our United Methodist heritage and a campus culture grounded in respect and care for others. Identified participants in the incident have been suspended from the football program indefinitely. "Based on what we currently know, this was an informal 'accountability' arrangement among a small group of players, rather than an official team rule. The investigation will establish how it originated and who knew about it."

articles.title: Gianni Infantino apologizes to FIFA Council for failed FFE plan as presidential election looms
articles.summary: Gianni Infantino has attempted to put the failed FIFA Forward Enterprise plan to rest at today's FIFA Council meeting in Zurich, Switzerland.
articles.body:
Gianni Infantino has attempted to put the failed FIFA Forward Enterprise plan to rest at today's FIFA Council meeting in Zurich, Switzerland.

The plan faced immense backlash after being revealed by The Times reporter Martyn Ziegler in the immediate aftermath of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Infantino's plan was to sell shares in a to-be-created business in charge of running the commercial enterprises of each future World Cup. A deal had already been struck for American entrepreneur Josh Kushner to invest in the project.

However, the plan was ultimately scrapped after facing blowback from all corners of the globe, including multiple FIFA confederations and executives. The plan was criticized not only for the perception that Infantino was selling football to the highest bidder, but also for the secrecy by which it was developed.

Gianni Infantino apologizes for failed FFE plan

According to FIFA Council member Ahmed Yahya, FIFA president Gianni Infantino apologized to the board for his failed FIFA Forward Enterprise plan that brought significant criticism in the wake of the 2026 World Cup.

"After finally withdrawing this proposal, President Gianni Infantino apologised to the members of the Executive Committee," said Yahya, the president of the Mauritania football association. "This was followed by a responsible debate, during which this issue was more or less shelved. And I believe that, in the interests of football, the Executive Committee is looking ahead and seeking solutions, above all with a positive attitude, by focusing on the good aspects that football has to offer today and trying to move forward."

Infantino himself then confirmed this while meeting with reporters after the meeting concluded.

"We had a very good meeting today, where we discussed the FIFA Forward Enterprise proposal, which was the main discussion point at the meeting today," Infantino said. "I apologized for the mistakes that we made in relation to the communication and consultation process related to the FIFA Forward Enterprise project, which had many consequences. "It's important to remember it was just a proposal, and in no way a done deal, just a proposal that actually intended to enable FIFA to invest more in our member associations as opposed to replacing support from existing resources. It's intention was merely to create more success stories like the ones that inspired people around the world during the FIFA 2026 World Cup, because football is for everyone."

It's intention was merely to create more success stories like the ones that inspired people around the world during the FIFA 2026 World Cup, because football is for everyone."

FIFA confirmed in a subsequent release that the FFE plan "has been permanently withdrawn and will not reappear in any form" and that Infantino's plan to distribute $6 billion in funding across the 211 member associations was also discussed positively.

Yahya reaffirmed his support for Infantino in the upcoming presidential election.

"There have been good ideas, such as the 48-team World Cup, which was initially contested by some but has proved vital for world football, and perhaps further projects will follow, but the key point for us – and to answer your question – is that we see Gianni as the right person to continue leading football.

"I've said that President Gianni Infantino is taking football forward worldwide. I come from the African continent and know what I'm talking about. He wants to promote football; he wants everyone to be involved, and that is precisely why we expanded the World Cup to 48 teams – and that is exactly what has delivered results."

"I am certain that Gianni Infantino is the right president," he concluded. "The majority want Gianni Infantino to stay."

Other topics addressed by Infantino in the three-and-a-half-hour meeting included US striker Folarin Balogun's suspended red-card ban at the World Cup, the FIFA Peace Prize, and funding for national associations, according to a report by the BBC .

However, not everyone was impressed with the responses given. "We asked a great many critical questions, but there were no satisfactory answers from my point of view," said FIFA Council member Bernd Neuendorf, the head of the German FA.

The next FIFA presidential election will take place on Thursday, March 18, 2027 at the next FIFA Congress meeting.

As of now, incumbent Gianni Infantino is the only confirmed individual to stand for election, as no challenger has stepped up yet to contest his station.

FIFA statutes allow Infantino to stand for re-election one more time, which would be his fourth term as FIFA president.

Individuals are allowed a maximum of three full terms as president. Infantino's first term as president came after a special election following the resignation of Sepp Blatter, which does not count towards his term limit.

articles.title: Ángel Torres reconoce conversaciones con Sancho... y no descarta a Parejo
articles.standfirst: "Para la semana que viene se podrá confirmar si cerramos o no estas negociaciones", dijo en Movistar Plus
articles.summary: "Para la semana que viene se podrá confirmar si cerramos o no estas negociaciones", dijo en Movistar Plus
articles.body: Ángel Torres reconoció en los micrófonos de Movistar Plus que están intentando fichar a Jadon Sancho... y no descarta a Dani Parejo. El dirigente azulón apuntó a la próxima semana como clave para saber si los dos ilustres futbolistas vestirán de azulón. "La lesión de Uche no hemos sido capaz de cubrirla. Estamos hablando con Sancho, al igual que hicimos hace tres o cuatro meses. Parejo también podría ser otra opción", señaló el presidente del Getafe. "Para la semana que viene se podrá confirmar si cerramos o no estas negociaciones", añadió. Dos nombres que se unirían al de Dani Carvajal, al que el Getafe ya ha fichado e inscrito. La dificultad que se encontraría el Getafe sería la misma que con el lateral: la ficha, en especial en el caso de Jadon Sancho, ya que Parejo, por su edad, probablemente tenga un caché muy inferior. En cualquier caso, Ángel Torres tendría que optar, casi con total seguridad, por la opción de avalar personalmente el fichaje. En el caso de tener que elegir, José Bordalás vería con mejores ojos el fichaje de Sancho, ya que considera que al Getafe le hace falta un extremo. Eso sí, el inglés sería más costoso. La próxima semana, clave. La referencia del gran rendimiento ofrecido por Mason Greenwood a las órdenes de José Bordalás anima al Getafe a intentar el fichaje de Sancho. Al igual que Jadon, Greenwood parecía, cuando llegó al Getafe, poco menos que un caso perdido, y en el Coliseum rindió de manera sobresaliente. Inglés, con pasado en el Manchester United, con gran potencial individual... los fichajes guardan semejanzas. Sancho está sin equipo desde el pasado 30 de junio, cuando terminó su contrato con el Manchester United. El Aston Villa, en forma de cesión, fue su última experiencia. Su campaña a las órdenes de Emery no fue precisamente la mejor: sólo dejó dos asistencias en la Premier y un gol y una asistencia en la Europa League. Sancho, de 26 años, llego a tener un valor de mercado en Transfermarkt de nada menos que 130 millones de euros en el año 2020. En 2019 quedó segundo en el Golden Boy por detrás de Joao Félix.

articles.body:
The long-rumored expansion of the College Football Playoff is getting closer to becoming a reality.

Per ESPN's Pete Thamel , the Playoff is nearing a deal to expand the field to 24 teams that would take effect with the 2027 season.

Thamel noted the new format is expected to be finalized in the "near future" as it goes through final approvals.

Updated College Football Playoff Predictions

The current 12-team playoff format was approved in 2022 and took effect with the 2024-25 season.

There has been discussion about expansion dating back to at least 2025 when the Big Ten proposed a format with between 24 to 28 teams. The proposal was met with some resistance in part because it called for eliminating conference title games.

Pete Nakos of On3.com reported the pending agreement will "likely" eliminate conference championship games and the first two rounds of the playoff will be played at the home site of the higher-seeded team.

Teams seeded No. 1 through 8 will receive a first-round bye. The quarterfinals, semifinals and championship game will be played at neutral sites.

The Big Ten and SEC — the two most prominent conferences in the country — have been at odds over expansion and the format of the playoff at times throughout the process.

Per a January report from ESPN's Heather Dinich , part of the issue stemmed from the SEC's preference for a 16-team format compared to the Big Ten's 24-team proposal.

There had been indications recently that tensions between the two conferences was thawing. SEC commissioner Greg Sankey told reporters on Wednesday that "some final decisions" would likely be made "sooner rather than later."

College football has used the playoff system since 2014. It began with a four-team format and remained that way through the 2023 season.

The 12-team format added eight games to the postseason schedule. Big Ten teams Ohio State and Indiana have won the national title in each of the first two years under the expanded field.

articles.title: College Football Playoff reportedly near deal to expand to 24 teams in 2027
articles.summary: The 12-team playoff is in its third season.
articles.body:
College Football Playoff expansion is almost here.

According to ESPN — the network that holds the broadcast rights to the current 12-team playoff — the CFP is "nearing a deal" to double the size of the field to 24 teams and that the agreement "is expected to come together in the near future."

The 2026 season is the third year of the 12-team playoff. The playoff was implemented ahead of the 2014 season and had a four-team field for its first 10 seasons.

Further playoff expansion has slowly become an inevitability in recent months after the Big Ten and SEC have haggled over the future format of the postseason. ESPN's current contract to televise the CFP goes through the 2031 season, and the network will reportedly buy the additional games from the 24-team playoff.

ESPN currently sublicenses a portion of the playoff to TNT, which has two first-round games, two quarterfinal games and a semifinal game this season.

The last major hurdle to expansion has been the future of conference championship games. The SEC's conference title game is the most recognizable and lucrative of the bunch, and commissioner Greg Sankey said this week at his conference's basketball media days that a decision on expansion would likely come "sooner rather than later."

Sankey was presumably speaking with the knowledge of the impending deal. The SEC has slowly come around on a bigger playoff field.

The official deadline to change next season's playoff format is Dec. 1, and meeting that deadline now seems like a formality. The playoff continued at 12 teams for a third season in 2026 after the Big Ten and SEC could not figure out what they wanted an expanded field to look like.

Big Ten commissioner Tony Petitti had initially pitched an expanded playoff field with a set number of automatic qualifiers from each conference.

As expansion talks droned on and on, the four power conferences also became aligned in their conference scheduling. The SEC is in its first year of a nine-game conference schedule as each of the ACC, Big 12, Big Ten and SEC all now play nine conference games and three non-conference games. The SEC also requires its members to play a power conference opponent (or Notre Dame) among its three non-conference games.

articles.title: Manchester United's Lisandro Martinez apologises for outburst and fined
articles.summary: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez issues an apology following his controversial remarks criticising the club's hierarchy.
articles.body:
Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez has issued an apology following his controversial remarks criticising the club's hierarchy.

After United's Champions League loss to Atletico Madrid on Tuesday Martinez said that the club had left head coach Michael Carrick with an under-equipped squad.

Following talks with United on Thursday, the Argentina international released a statement.

"Today I met with the club's leadership and the manager," Martinez said in a social media post.

"It was a very positive conversation, where we were able to exchange views and speak openly about what happened after Tuesday's game.

"Everyone knows that I am a passionate person and that I live football with great intensity.

"The frustration of the defeat led me to express how I felt at a time and place that perhaps were not the right ones, and for that I want to apologise."

It is understood Martinez has been formally punished for his outburst with a fine.

Carrick will hold a news conference on Friday, prior to the game against Leeds United on Sunday.

He takes his side to Elland Road on the back of just two wins from nine games this season, placed 13th in the Premier League with six points from as many games.

Following the loss to Atletico, Martinez said he expected more investment in the Manchester United squad and "more from our technical director [Jason Wilcox]".

The 28-year-old later said he "spoke out of anger and frustration" in making those comments and that he had "belief in my team-mates, our manager and everyone working to help this club move forward".

Former Manchester United captain Roy Keane, speaking on The Overlap podcast, , external described the situation at his former club as "a bit of a circus".

Martinez's statement on Thursday added: "Our club is at its best when we are all united, and I recognise that my words in that moment did not help with that.

"I know that every single person at Manchester United is doing everything possible to achieve our shared ambition: bringing the success that this club and its supporters deserve.

"With this situation now behind us, we are fully focused on winning together."

It remains to be seen whether Carrick selects Martinez for the trip to Leeds .

Nevertheless, there is understood to be significant doubt over the centre-back's long-term future at Old Trafford.

His current deal expires at the end of the season but the club have the option of extending it by 12 months.

While the issue over his recent comments is now considered closed, the club are still to decide whether they want to trigger the contract option.

articles.title: Kirby Smart, Curt Cignetti Voted Among Most-Trusted CFB HCs in Poll, Full Results Revealed
articles.summary: Indiana's Curt Cignetti is the reigning national champion in college football, and Georgia's Kirby Smart is the last one to win back-to-back titles.
articles.body:
Indiana's Curt Cignetti is the reigning national champion in college football, and Georgia's Kirby Smart is the last one to win back-to-back titles.

And, perhaps unsurprisingly, their peers trust them to win one game more than any other coaches in the country.

Bruce Feldman of The Athletic surveyed 34 Division I head coaches, assistant coaches and general managers and asked them which coach they trusted the most to win one single game. The only caveat was they could not vote for their own team's head coach, and Smart and Cignetti received a head-turning 82 percent of the votes.

There were only five coaches who received even a single vote:

The coaches who did not receive a vote may be as notable as the ones who did. Ohio State's Ryan Day and Clemson's Dabo Swinney are both national champion-winning coaches. Some marquee names such as Marcus Freeman, Lane Kiffin, Steve Sarkisian and Dan Lanning also didn't receive a vote.

Yet UCLA's Bob Chesney, New Mexico's Jason Eck and Houston's Willie Fritz did receive votes.

There is likely something to be said about their ability to win at nontraditional powerhouses, especially in an era where resources devoted to the football program is so important.

However, nobody has done that better than Cignetti.

He took over Indiana when it was the losingest program in college football history and immediately led the Hoosiers to the College Football Playoff in his first season and national championship in his second season.

"Cignetti has my vote," a head coach said. "I have a special place in my heart for guys that take bad jobs and make them good. Anyone can win at certain places. What he has done is incredible."

The Hoosiers are undefeated once again this season and face a significant challenge with Day's Buckeyes on Saturday.

As for Smart, a wide receivers coach called him a "master motivator" and pointed out "his teams rarely show up flat, regardless of opponent level."

That trait will be tested Saturday, as the Bulldogs face a struggling Auburn squad after a marquee victory over Alabama. Avoiding any type of letdown as the season progresses will be key if Smart's team is going to be a factor in the championship race once again.

articles.title: Principio de acuerdo Bayern-Kane
articles.standfirst: El '9' y el club habrían llegado a un pacto verbal que debe ser ratificado en breve
articles.summary: El '9' y el club habrían llegado a un pacto verbal que debe ser ratificado en breve
articles.body: En el Allianz Arena pueden respirar tranquilos. Salvo giro inesperado, Harry Kane (Leytonstone, 1993) seguirá en el Bayern. Según informa Michael Bridge, periodista de 'SkySports', el ex del Tottenham, fichado en 2023 a cambio de 95 millones de euros, habría llegado a un acuerdo verbal para ampliar su contrato hasta 2029. "Las conversaciones van bien. He sido bastante abierto y honesto al respecto. Todavía estamos en negociaciones y creo que están avanzando de la manera correcta. Ambas partes han estado muy relajadas al respecto. Todos pueden ver que estoy feliz allí, la forma en que estoy rindiendo, la forma en que hablo fuera del campo. Espero que se concrete algo. En el próximo mes aproximadamente debería haber algún tipo de decisión y creo que será positiva", vaticinaba Kane, que acababa contrato en junio, a finales de septiembre. "El capitán de la selección inglesa y su familia están disfrutando de la vida en Múnich. Se entiende que el club de la Bundesliga está ultimando los trámites para la renovación de su contrato", añade 'Sky Sports'. De lo que no se cansa Kane, candidato a ganar el Balón de Oro, es de marcar goles. Desde su llegada en 2023, acumula 154 goles y 37 asistencias en 156 partidos. No sólo eso. Puso fin a su sequía de títulos. Con el Bayern ha conquistado dos Ligas (2024-25 y 2025-26), una Copa (2025-26) y dos Supercopas alemanas (2025 y 2026).

articles.title: El Madrid ficha a Bernd Reichart, CEO de A22 Sports Management
articles.standfirst: El ejecutivo alemán se incorpora al organigrama económico del club blanco
articles.summary: El ejecutivo alemán se incorpora al organigrama económico del club blanco
articles.body: Bernd Reichart, ejecutivo alemán conocido en España por ser el CEO de A22, la empresa detrás del proyecto de la Superliga, se incorpora al Real Madrid. Pasará a dirigir el área de negocio de la entidad del Bernabéu, bajo la supervisión del director general ejecutivo del club blanco, José Ángel Sánchez. Reinhart fue durante años la cabeza visible de A22 Sports Management, la empresa creada en 2022 para impulsar el proyecto de la Superliga. Ahora, según adelantó As y han confirmado a MARCA fuentes del Real Madrid, pasa a integrar la estructura económica del club blanco, en dependencia del CEO de la entidad. Tras el acuerdo del pasado mes de febrero entre el Real Madrid y la UEFA para dejar atrás el proyecto de la Superliga, Reichart, de 52 años, afronta una nueva etapa profesional en España, país al que ha estado muy ligado a lo largo de su vida personal y profesional. Estudió un tiempo en la Universidad de Salamanca a finales de los años 90 y, entre 2004 y 2013, dirigió distintos proyectos en el grupo Atresmedia. Su paso al Real Madrid se produce tras la firma de la paz entre el Real Madrid y la UEFA, que limita el radio de acción de A22, nacida para impulsar una transformación del fútbol europeo con medidas que poco a poco se van implementando en sus competiciones, en especial la Champions League, la joya de la corona del organismo europeo.

articles.title: Un misil de Gudelj para hacer justicia en la fiesta de Gica
articles.standfirst: El cuadro azulón mereció el punto y rompe su mala racha de cinco derrotas lejos del Coliseum
articles.summary: El cuadro azulón mereció el punto y rompe su mala racha de cinco derrotas lejos del Coliseum
articles.body: Un golazo de Gudelj dio el primer punto a un Getafe que se lo mereció en este arranque de Conference y de paso, acabó con la mala racha de cinco derrotas lejos del Coliseum esta temporada. Tuvo más el balón el equipo de Bordalás, manejó mejor el partido, pero un error de Valou pudo haberle condenado si no es por el golazo del serbio. El primer minuto fue para Gica Craioveanu. Han pasado casi 35 años desde que dejó su sello en Craiova con su zurda de seda, pero la gente le sigue adorando. No hay más que ver el mosaico que prepararon en un fondo y la fiesta con bengalas incluidas que se vivió en el estadio para honrar la figura de uno de los mejores futbolistas de la historia de Rumanía. Y del Craiova y del Geta también. Grande. El Getafe salió al campo con carácter y dispuesto manejar el partido. Sin cuatro titulares lesionados y sin su último galáctico, Dani Carvajal, que queda de momento solo para Liga y Copa, los de Bordalás se plantaron de inicio con las novedades en la titularidad de Borja Mayoral y Valou, casi inéditos esta temporada. Y ambos hicieron una buena primera parte para ir apagándose hasta el punto de que un error del joven central canterano del Villarreal puso por delante al Craiova. Los azules fueron mejores de inicio e incluso perdonaron en las botas de Mayoral, en la ocasión más clara en el minuto 12 tras una gran jugada de Andrés García por la derecha. Al Getafe le sentó bien el cambio de sistema, con Gudelj de mediocentro en vez de central: así se apoderó del balón y controló a un Craiova que no encontraba su juego. Pero los rumanos esperaron su momento. Pudo haber sido antes del descanso con un error de Gudelj que estuvo a punto de convertir en gol Al Hamlawi. No fue entonces, pero sí en el minuto 60 cuando el primer fallo del joven Valou lo aprovechó el 9 del Craiova para hacer el gol que ponía por delante a los locales para locura del estadio Oblemenco. El Getafe esta temporada tiene un agujero en el centro de la defensa visto el rendimiento de Abqar y Sazonov y las dudas de Zaid. Y a eso se añadió el fallo de Valou, que hasta entonces había hecho un buen partido. Los errores individuales hacen daño a un equipo al que luego le cuesta mucho remontar. Lo intentó hasta el final el equipo de Bordalás. Tiró de orgullo, cambió las pocas piezas que tenía y el canterano Risco ayudó al equipo cuando mas lo necesitaba. Y el gol de Gudelj hizo justicia a un Getafe que fue mejor en muchos momentos de este estreno europeo. Buen punto para empezar.

articles.title: A la Real se le va la victoria en el 88
articles.standfirst: El conjunto txuriurdin no cuajó un buen partido en su visita al USG, pero se adelantó nada más comenzar la segunda parte, con un gol de Turrientes que no supo aguantar hasta el final
articles.summary: El conjunto txuriurdin no cuajó un buen partido en su visita al USG, pero se adelantó nada más comenzar la segunda parte, con un gol de Turrientes que no supo aguantar hasta el final
articles.body: La Real Sociedad acarició hasta el minuto 88 ser el primer visitante en ganar al USG en Bélgica y estrenar su casillero de victorias en esta Europa League, pero Keita igualó entonces el tanto que había hecho Turrientes y dejó en un punto al bagaje de los txuriurdin en la segunda jornada del torneo continental. La primera acción de peligro fue una contra de Oyarzabal, que se plantó sólo delante de Koffi, pero sin que finalmente tuviera validez por un ligero fuera de juego. El USG no tardó en asustar a la Real, con una falta muy cerrada que peinó Sylla y, tras tocar en Jon Martín, terminó con el balón estrellándose en el poste izquierdo de una portería txuriurdin que poco después buscó Mofokeng con un disparo cercano que se le fue alto. Otro chut de Olaru desde la frontal que fue a las menos de Marrero confirmó la mejor salida de los belgas al encuentro. El conjunto de Matarazzo volvió a aparecer con una muy buena combinación de unos cuantos jugadores, con Oyarzabal disparando y encontrándose con la pierna de Sylla y un sorprendente Zubeldia al borde del área recogiendo el rechace y mandando la pelota rozando el travesaño. El nuevo remate cercano de Mofokeng avisó de que los locales no se habían asustado y por eso, como el propio técnico realista había avisado la víspera, su escuadra buscó entonces controlar un poco más el juego, pidiendo un penalti por manos que no lo parecieron, poco antes del descanso. Matarazzo movió el banquillo en el descanso y dio entrada a Turrientes, que en el primer balón que tocó puso el 0-1, al aprovechar una cesión corta de Van de Perre a su portero, cuando no había pasado ni un minuto de la reanudación. La desventaja no afectó al USG, porque enseguida el activo Mofokeng se revolvió en el área de Marrero y le chutó, aunque muy débil a sus manos, como también fue luego otro disparo de Olaru. La Real reaccionó con la mejor acción de Ochieng en el partido, una internada por la banda derecha con un pase al punto de penalti, donde apareció Sucic, pero el remate con su pierna mala, la derecha, se le fue arriba. Mofokeng volvió a probar fortuna, pero con otro disparo flojo, marchándosele alto el que hizo enseguida Guilherme. Como los belgas otra vez controlaban el partido y llegaban al área de Marrero con más frecuencia de la deseada, Matarazzo apareció de nuevo desde su banquillo para intentar poner más de cara el partido para su equipo, primero con la entrada de Kubo y luego con las de Marín y Barrenetxea. El japonés forzó un córner y dio un poco de aire a los txuriurdin, que no contaban con que, a menos de tres minutos para el final, Keita remató en boca de gol una falta que Zubeldia peinó en su intento de despejar un balón que se convirtió en el 1-1 final, porque Sylla salvó de manera milagrosa sobre la línea la última ocasión guipuzcoana.

articles.title: Cissé lidera a un Milan que no necesita a Modric para golear al Salzburgo
articles.standfirst: El italiano realizó un hat-trick para darle los tres puntos a su equipo
articles.summary: El italiano realizó un hat-trick para darle los tres puntos a su equipo
articles.body: El Milan salió con la unidad 'B' para enfrentase al Salzburgo. Sin embargo, eso no impidió que se adelantasen rápido. Transcurrido el primer cuarto de hora, el conjunto italiano hizo una buena jugada por la banda derecha. Hutchinson realizó un gran centro y Cissé con un cabezazo ajustado a la esquina inferior izquierda adelantó a los suyos. Pasados otros quince minutos, Cissé firmaba un doblete tras empujar el pase de Bartesaghi. Tras volver del descanso, Cissé puso el hat-trick en su cuenta tras empujar el centro de Rabiot, en una jugada que comenzó con una ocasión muy clara del Salzburo y que subió al marcador por pocos centímetros. Pasada la hora de partido, Allegri sacó a varios de los jugadores más importantes de la plantilla, como Luka Modric, Christian Pulisic o Gonçalo Ramos. El portugués fue el encargado de aumentar la distancia, tras una gran recuperación de Jashari cerca del área del Salzburgo. Ramos puso el cuarto con un disparo colocado con la izquierda, doce minutos después de salir para completar una goleada. Era uno de los grandes partidos de la jornada. Y el Lyon quería hacerse fuerte en su campo como local. Tan solo hicieron falta ocho minutos para que Tolisso aprovechase un rechace en un córner y batiese la meta inglesa. Al borde del descanso, Nuamah se encargó de aumentar la diferencia tras rematar en el corazón del área el centro de Nakamura. El Palace quería despertar tras el entretiempo. Wharton realizó un gran pase filtrado que encontró a Yeremi Pino dentro del área. El español definió con la izquierda para recortar distancias. 25 minutos después, Sulc empujó de tacón el remate de Nakamura para volver a poner dos goles de diferencia. Querían puntuar los ingleses y tras cinco minutos, Kamada volvió a poner al Palace a un gol tras aprovechar un rechace dentro del área pequeña. Pero los esfuerzos ingleses no sirvieron para puntuar en tierras francesas. El Leverkusen era el favorito para llevarse el encuentro. Y así lo demostraron los primeros minutos, intentando derribar la muralla polaca con varias llegadas al área. El gol finalmente acabó llegando desde el punto de penalti, por medio de Schick que entró al campo para sustituir al lesionado Terrier. Tan solo tres minutos después, Tillman puso el segundo con un gol en el que tuvo mucha fortuna. Al borde del descanso, Schick puso el tercero en el marcador y el segundo en su cuenta particular, otra vez de penalti. Los alemanes continuaron con su empeño ofensivo en la segunda mitad, aunque con menos efectividad que en los primeros 45 minutos. Pero Maza quería su gol, y se encargó de finiquitar una gran jugada colectiva con una buena definición colocada al palo para certificar la goleada. El Mónaco visitaba el feudo del CSKA Sofia. Tan solo hicieron falta tres minutos para que los franceses se adelantasen por medio de Brunner, que aprovechó un rechace dentro del área y mando el balón a guardar con un disparo ajustado al palo. Rozando el descanso, el delantero alemán le devolvió el balón a Ansu Fati en las inmediaciones del área, y el español ponía el segundo con un remate cruzado con la izquierda. Sin embargo, los locales no iban a vender barata la derrota. Zwarts recortó distancias en un córner para avisar a los franceses. Pero el Mónaco se hizo fuerte y logró llevarse la victoria. En este encuentro de Conference había duelo nacional en los banquillos. Gonzalo García con el Hajduk Split y Míchel con el Ajax. Un duelo igualado en el que el primer golpe lo asestaron los locales por medio de Sanyang Bamba, gracias a un gran disparo cruzado. En el 53, Klaasen recortó distancias con un golazo, que llegó con un gran control y una buena defnición ante la que el meta local no pudo hacer nada. Sin embargo, dos minutos después, una pérdida atrás provocó que Sego recuperase el balón y se lo entregase a Soticek, que solo tuvo que empujarlo para volver a poner a su equipo por delante. El partido tuvo que detenerse por humo de fuegos artificiales que no dejaban ver. Sin embargo, eso no impidió que el Hajduk Split se llevase la victoria.

articles.title: Lisandro Martinez: Man Utd defender apologises for outburst and holds talks with Jason Wilcox and Michael Carrick
articles.summary: Man Utd defender Lisandro Martinez called out the club's hierarchy after their Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid; Martinez said he had expected more from "upstairs", singling out technical director Jason Wilcox
articles.body:
Martinez launched an extraordinary attack on the club's hierarchy after the 2-0 defeat in Spain, as he criticised the lack of summer investment in the squad and said he expected more from "upstairs" after he singled out technical director Jason Wilcox.

Sky Sports News understands Martinez met the club's hierarchy, including Wilcox and CEO Omar Berrada, on Thursday. Head coach Michael Carrick was also present at the meeting.

In a statement released on Thursday night, the defender said: "Today I met with the club's leadership and the manager.

"It was a very positive conversation, where we were able to exchange views and speak openly about what happened after Tuesday's game.

"Everyone knows that I am a passionate person and that I live football with great intensity.

"The frustration of the defeat led me to express how I felt at a time and place that perhaps were not the right ones, and for that I want to apologise.

"Our club is at its best when we are all united, and I recognise that my words in that moment did not help with that.

"I know that every single person at Manchester United is doing everything possible to achieve our shared ambition: bringing the success that this club and its supporters deserve.

"With this situation now behind us, we are fully focused on winning together."

Sky Sports News understands it was Martinez's decision to publicly apologise and any disciplinary decisions or internal conversations will be kept private between him and the club, but he has reportedly been fined.

The club now consider the matter closed as they prepare for Leeds on Sunday, live on Sky Sports.

On Wednesday, Martinez issued a statement to clarify his outburst, but did not apologise.

"In pre-season, the players all spoke about how close this group has been since Carrick was appointed.

"This will now really be tested. At least one player confronted Martinez after his comments.

"On balance, I spoke to Harry Maguire and others this season, who have talked about the need to bring in as many players as possible.

"Where this leaves the changing room? We'll have to find out. But for Carrick, this is the last thing he needed.

"Now they have to face another distraction as the pressure mounts on the head coach."

Sky Sports News' Football Correspondent Rob Dorsett :

There are real doubts about whether Martinez's contract will be extended when it expires in the summer.

Manchester United will focus on revamping their defence in the next transfer windows and have the formal option to prolong Martinez's stay for a further year.

Sky Sports News has been told United are looking at new centre-backs, as well as left-backs.

It is also understood that there is no pressure on Wilcox internally regarding his position.

Martinez has been keen on a move away from Old Trafford for some time.

In the summer, he pushed for a move to Atletico Madrid, the side that beat United in the Champions League on Tuesday night, to follow his good friend and international team-mate, Cristian Romero, who left Spurs for Spain.

No suitable bid for Martinez came in for Manchester United to consider.

The 28-year-old made similar explosive comments about his bosses when at Ajax in 2022. Martinez, who again wanted a move away, called their sporting director Gerry Hamstra a "nobody".

articles.title: Premier League predictions: Chris Sutton v boxer & Ipswich fan Fabio Wardley - & AI
articles.summary: BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on boxer and Ipswich fan Fabio Wardley, plus the BBC readers and AI with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures.
articles.body:
The pressure is mounting on Manchester United boss Michael Carrick after his side's poor start, but will things improve when they face rivals Leeds on Saturday?

"I cannot remember the last time Leeds were seen as favourites going into this fixture but I don't fancy Manchester United 's chances at all," said BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton.

" Leeds are just a much more rounded team. Their fans must be relishing this game."

Sutton is making predictions for all 380 Premier League games this season, against AI, BBC Sport readers and a variety of guests.

For week seven, he takes on former heavyweight boxing world champion Fabio Wardley, who supports Ipswich Town .

Wardley can reclaim his WBO title when he meets Daniel Dubois at London's O2 Arena on Saturday.

The fight, a rematch of their thrilling battle in May, when Dubois stopped Wardley in the 11th round to take his crown, will be shown live on DAZN and you can listen to live commentary on BBC Radio 5 Live as well as following a live watchalong on BBC iPlayer.

Wardley took Sutton on at predictions before that first fight too - so will either outcome be different this time?

"I beat Fabio last time - he's from Ipswich so he doesn't stand a chance of beating me," Sutton said.

"But good luck to him on Saturday night and I hope he wins his rematch - he's got a better chance against Dubois than he has against me."

Do you agree with their predictions? You can pick your own below.

The most popular scoreline selected for each game is used in the scoreboards and tables at the bottom of this page.

A correct result (picking a win, draw or defeat) is worth 10 points. The exact score earns 40 points.

Want to make more predictions? You can play BBC Sport's new Match of the Day predictor game every week, featuring six fixtures from domestic and European competition.

It took Ipswich 19 matches and until 30 December to rack up three wins the last time they were promoted to the Premier League, in 2024-25, but their new-look side have already matched that total in their first six games.

"Whenever you get promoted there is going to be a large amount of player turnover because, if you want to stay up, then you need to bring some players in who are going to be game-changers, and are going to offer you the different perspectives or different outlets you will need at this level," Wardley told BBC Sport.

"With a bunch of new players and a new manager in Gary O'Neil too, there was always going to be a question mark as to how well they would gel, or even how quickly, but the team are looking great.

"You only have to look at the start we've made to the season to answer the question of whether we look like we belong in the Premier League.

"Three wins from six games is a great start for any team coming up from the Championship and the boys are doing really well right now."

Wardley has seen two of those wins for himself, with both of them coming thanks to last-gasp goals.

"My training camp has been very strict and very stringent so I've been very busy with a lot of what I've got going on, but of course I've tried to make it to Portman Road as much as possible," he added.

"I went to the first game of the season against Sunderland , which ended with a nice little last-minute winner for us, with Jack Clarke sticking that one in.

"And just before I came away for the build-up to my fight, I was at Saturday's game against Fulham , which ended in a similar fashion really.

"We went 1-0 down early on but clawed it back and then scored two goals in three minutes, with the winner coming in added time.

"Winning like that proves the team have got character. The boys are showing a lot of resilience and we are going to need it this season."

Chris Sutton and Fabio Wardley were speaking to BBC Sport's Chris Bevan.

The AI predictions were generated using Microsoft Copilot Chat - we simply asked the tool to 'predict this weekend's Premier League scores'.

Everton are still unbeaten and, as well as their results, they have really impressed me with the way they have played so far.

Bournemouth had a better xG than Chelsea last weekend, but lost 5-1. That game showed again how Xabi Alonso's side are going to be enjoyable to watch this season but very difficult to predict.

You just don't know what you are going to get with Chelsea at the moment but at least you know what to expect from Everton .

They are always so well organised and should probably have beaten Hull last time out, with the number of good chances Thierno Barry had.

I can see them making things awkward for Chelsea and maintaining that unbeaten start.

Brentford are another team to have made an unbeaten start, and while I thought they were a bit lucky to get a draw at Aston Villa last week, they have plenty of momentum.

Liverpool got a big win on their travels in the Champions League against LASK on Wednesday but there are two ways to look at that result.

On one hand, they looked good going forward and it was great for Bradley Barcola to open his account with a hat-trick.

But, at the same time, they conceded three goals and they still have that vulnerability about them at the back.

If the Reds empty the midfield again in this game then they are going to be in trouble, because Brentford are quite direct and will keep looking to run in behind the Liverpool defence.

The sceptics will say Barcola needs to start delivering in the Premier League too, and Florian Wirtz has been taking a bit of a battering for his performances.

The question I asked on the Monday Night Club was 'what kind of player actually is he?'

They have paid so much money for him but is he a dribbler? No. He's not the kind of player to shoot and score from the edge of the box either.

He's got an intelligent football brain but Liverpool wanted more than that. When you spend so much on a player, you want some numbers from him.

This is a tricky game for Liverpool , and I don't think they will win it. They definitely won't keep a clean sheet, either.

This feels like a massive game for Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa, who is still waiting for his first league win.

They had it in the bag against Ipswich last week so losing that game so late on was just desperate for them.

I've watched Fulham a couple of times this season, against Liverpool and Manchester United , and they played well both times without getting over the line.

After this game, they go to Coventry next. I know the Cottagers are not a club known for going through managers but if they lose this then the pressure will really be on Arbeloa.

Hull , in contrast, will be relishing this after the start they have made.

Their identity is as a team who will have a real go at you and their approach is a bit like a bull in a china shop.

It has been working pretty well so far and I think they will fancy their chances against a Fulham side who might be lacking a bit of belief.

Despite that, I am going to go with Fulham here. I don't think their results have really reflected their performances so far, but that might change on Saturday.

Manchester City will have learned a lot from their defeat by Paris St-Germain.

I was there for Radio 5 Live and I thought City's second-half display was a magnificent response.

For those teams to meet at this early stage of the Champions League it was always going to be a good game, but it was never going to be tense because neither side were going to be knocked out.

PSG showed how good they are in the first half hour, but City will have gained a lot of confidence from their response. If they end up playing PSG again later in the competition, that second half will have done them the world of good psychologically.

There is obviously a lot of noise around City at the moment but in that game and against Liverpool last week, you could see the unity in their team.

They played with such intensity in the second half against PSG that I wonder how much that has taken out of them, but they will want to keep their foot on the throttle.

Fair play to Ipswich , for coming back to beat Fulham the way they did, but I don't see them getting anything here.

We know Gary O'Neil's side will have a go and I really like their approach this season, but City will have too much quality for them.

Fabio on the Ipswich players who have impressed him this season: A few do stand out. Julio Enciso is doing a lot in the middle of the park and then there is Leif Davis, who has been there for a long time and is part of the core of the team. Another one who doesn't always get much of a mention is our goalkeeper Christian Walton. He had to battle for his place and has been in and out of the side but he always seems to claw his way back in and he has proved why he is the main man between the sticks.

Fabio's prediction: The boys have got a tall order on Saturday. Look, playing City is no joke for anyone in the Premier League, especially a team that has just come up, but as I've been saying this week about my own situation in my fight, having an underdog mentality can be a good thing - it does free you up and kind of take the weight off your shoulders, and it allows the boys to play and just do their thing.

It's a big ask to go away to City and get a result but hopefully they can pull something off and come away with at least a point. 1-1

Newcastle 's defeat at Coventry on Monday was such a wild game. The way the Magpies play, they just go for it, and load players into the front line.

They lost 4-1 in the end but the scoreline could have been anything with the number of chances Newcastle had.

Aston Villa have made a slow start to the Premier League season results-wise but I think they done all right, bearing in mind what their manager Unai Emery has had to deal with in terms of the players they lost.

Johan Manzambi is getting fitter every game and Nicolas Jackson has found some great form.

It takes time for a team to come together but I thought they were really good against Brentford last weekend, but just weren't ruthless enough. That wasn't a problem against Fenerbahce on Wednesday, though.

This is a really hard one to call and the only thing I know for certain is that there will be a few goals.

Both these teams play in Europe on Thursday but neither of them are in great form. Sunderland have lost three in a row, while Bournemouth have not won in the league so far this season.

The Cherries have been a team who have got in front but let things slip a few times this season but, against Chelsea , they went 2-0 down right from kick-off, then did it again with their third goal inside the first few seconds of the second half.

Bournemouth boss Marco Rose had probably told his players "don't do anything stupid" at the break, so he must have been absolutely livid at that.

They really need a positive result here but so do Sunderland . It's going to be close, and I can't pick a winner.

I am not quite sure how Crystal Palace beat Nottingham Forest last week, because Forest had some incredible chances.

I don't see the Eagles getting anything here, though, because Brighton are absolutely flying at the moment.

The Seagulls showed great resilience to hold on at 1-0 with 10 men in their win against Sunderland last week and ended up scoring a second goal right at the end too.

Again, both teams play in Europe on Thursday so they will have to find the right balance with their team selections - but I don't see it affecting Brighton any more than it will Palace.

I found Lisandro Martinez's outburst about Manchester United 's recruitment very strange, especially after his mistake that cost his side victory over Tottenham .

You'd think Martinez would keep his head down after making a mess of the cross that let Dominic Solanke equalise - If I am United's director of football Jason Wilcox then, in January, I am buying a big left-sided centre-half who can deal with crosses to take his place.

While some Manchester United fans might agree with what Martinez said, there is a time and a place to do it and it felt like a really poor error of judgement.

It just shows what kind of state Manchester United are in at the moment, though. Don't forget that Spurs played them off the park early on in that game.

Maybe they will up their game and find a way to win this time because they are getting desperate - but I don't see it.

I think Leeds will beat them, and beat them convincingly.

So far this season I have backed Manchester United most weeks but I have had enough of that. I must have lost my head to stick with them so long - not any more.

Nottingham Forest held Arsenal 0-0 here last season but I don't think they have got a clean sheet in them this time.

Forest were actually pretty good in their defeat against Crystal Palace , but just didn't take their chances.

I can't see them causing Arsenal too many problems, however. The Gunners had a good win over Lille in the Champions League on Tuesday and this should be just as comfortable for them.

Tottenham will be fresh from their training camp in Marbella and we are about to find out if it worked.

If they don't beat Coventry and get their first win of the season, then they will probably have to go back out there next week as well.

Being serious, they do look like they are improving already and they played well against Manchester United last week.

Coventry are a dangerous counter-attacking team, and their pace in forward areas will cause problems, but this is going to be Tottenham 's night.

Chris was the only predictor who saw Manchester City 's win at Liverpool coming.

Including City's 3-0 victory at Anfield, he got four correct results with no exact scores from the 10 games in week six, giving him 40 points.

articles.title: Un regreso feliz truncado al final
articles.standfirst: Turirientes volvió a jugar tras dos partidos sin hacerlo y nada más pisar el césped adelantó a la Real, pero al final su primer gol del curso no sirvió para lograr la victoria
articles.summary: Turirientes volvió a jugar tras dos partidos sin hacerlo y nada más pisar el césped adelantó a la Real, pero al final su primer gol del curso no sirvió para lograr la victoria
articles.body: Beñat Turrientes no tardó en aprovechar su vuelta a los terrenos de juego con la Real Sociedad, después de no tener minutos en los dos últimos encuentros, tras haber jugado en los seis primeros del curso y en cuatro de ellos como titular, y antes de que pasasen 60 segundos desde su entrada al campo en Bélgica adelantó al conjunto txuriurdin al aprovechar una falta de entendimiento entre Van de Perre y el portero Koffi. Turrientes fue la solución a la que Pellegrino Matarazzo recurrió en el descanso del partido en Lovaina, con 0-0 en el marcador y la evidencia de que el doble pivote formado por Jon Gorrotxategi y Yangel Herrera dejaba a deber en la creación, lo que influyó en las poquísimas oportunidades que hubo para marcar. El 8 se había quedado inédito ante el Valencia, antes del parón, y frente al Dépor, después, y por lo que esa acción seguro que le sirve para recuperar la confianza que podía haber perdido, lástima para él que la Real no pudiera aguantar esa ventaja que había logrado, porque muy poco antes del pitido final el joven jugador local Keita puso el que sería 1-1 definitivo. Fue la primera diana que Beñat Turrientes aporta en esta temporada 2026-27, dedicada como siempre al cielo en honor a su padre, fallecido hace unos años cuando él era un niño. El internacional logró tres el curso pasado, en el que estuvo a punto de salir de la Real en enero, una decisión que cambió la llegada de Matarazzo, con el que contó mucho más que con Sergio Francisco al inicio. Turrientes trabajará ahora para volver a entrar en la rotación de un Matarazzo que no había echado mano de él en los últimos dos partidos y que en la víspera de la cita en Lovaina pidió más de él. El tanto puede ser el primer paso para regresar de manera más habitual al equipo titular de la Real.

articles.title: Lyon 3-2 Crystal Palace: Pierre Sage suffers defeat to former side as Eagles comeback falls short in Europa League
articles.summary: Match report as Lyon beat Crystal Palace 3-2 in the Europa League; Eagles boss Pierre Sage suffers defeat to his former side; Corentin Tolisso, Ernest Nuamah and Pavel Sulc scored for Lyon; goals from Yeremy Pino and Daichi Kamada couldn't spark the comeback
articles.body:
Lyon raced into a two-goal lead thanks to goals from Corentin Tolisso and Ernest Nuamah either side of the first half and looked comfortable while ahead, with Palace offering little in the form of a response without a shot on target.

Sage, facing the club that sacked him in January 2025, sparked a reaction after the interval with Yeremy Pino pulling a goal back with his fine strike at the near post in the 50th minute.

Pavel Sulc's flick to divert Keito Nakamura's shot looked to have ended any hopes of a comeback until Daichi Kamada, who had already seen a strong claim for a penalty waved away despite contact from Nuamah, halved the deficit with under 10 minutes to go.

The resurgence ultimately fell short and means Palace suffered defeat to the team that cost them their place in the Europa League last season due to former co-owner John Textor also being a majority owner in the Ligue 1 side.

The Eagles will now look to bounce back when they face rivals Brighton, live on Sky Sports , this Sunday before a tough trip to Besiktas in their next European outing.

8: GOAL! Lyon take an early lead after Tolisso reacts first in the box to sweep home following lacklustre Palace defending.

45+2: GOAL! Nuamah doubles the lead for Lyon just before the break after guiding his effort into the back of the net.

21: GAME ON? Pino pulls one back with fine strike into the roof of the net following Adam Wharton's fine pass into the box.

68: PENALTY CLAIM! Daichi Kamada goes down inside the area after being bundled over by Nuamah but play is waved on and VAR clears the incident.

76: GOAL! Sulc flicks Keito Nakamura's shot into the back of the net to restore two-goal lead.

81: COMEBACK ON? Kamada sparks hopes of a comeback after halving the deficit with under 10 minutes to go.

Sage: Disappointing return, we were nowhere near our standards

"It's a very disappointing return because we lost. I can't take satisfaction from coming back home or seeing familiar faces when the result isn't there.

"The scoreline may have been close, but there was a big difference in the way the two teams played.

"We were nowhere near our usual standards in the first half. We improved considerably after the break and gave ourselves a chance, but conceding that third goal made things difficult.

"I think our second-half efforts deserved an equaliser, although winning would have been a generous reward given that we only really played [to our level] for one half."

Lyon were a mountain Palace couldn't climb

"Like the game against Nottingham Forest, Crystal Palace fell behind early doors. The first half was a timid but one sided affair. Palace offered nothing and failed to register a shot on target in the first 45 minutes.

"The improvement did come after the restart, a positive sign of the impact Pierre Sage can have with his half-time team talks, but the third for Lyon always seemed like a step too far.

"Palace kept pushing and halved the deficit once more but left themselves with far too much to do with time ticking down.

"It is a new era at Selhurst Park with Sage and consistency is not in their repertoire as things stand. One thing they can address to give themselves the best chance in the meantime is their vulnerability from set pieces.

"The opener came from failing to clear their lines from a routine corner, as Corentin Tolisson reacted quickest to sweep home.

"Palace have shipped 35 set-piece goals in all competitions since the start of last season, a figure only two Premier League side have exceeded (Chelsea on 37 and Newcastle on 36). It is a clear weakness in their play and needs to be addressed sooner, rather than later, if they are to progress under the new boss."

What the result means and next fixtures...

articles.title: Torreense 1-2 Sunderland: Noah Sadiki scores late winner to earn second Europa League win as Black Cats survive big scare
articles.summary: Match report as Sunderland earn second Europa League win of league phase by beating Torreense; hosts took shock lead through Volnei's wondergoal; Regis Le Bris had to bring on regular first-teamers after making seven changes; Jules Ahoka headed in equaliser; Noah Sadiki netted late winner
articles.body:
Regis Le Bris' side made hard work of their first European away fixture in 53 years, trailing at half-time to the Portuguese second division club, who took a shock lead through centre-back Volnei Feltes' outstanding strike from 25 yards that nestled in the top right corner.

Sunderland were frustrated during the first-half when Timur Tuterov's close-range header from Luke O'Nien's long throw was ruled out for a soft foul, but it was no excuse for a poor performance, failing to have a shot on target until the 57th minute.

Le Bris had made seven changes and was forced to bring on regular first-teamers Enzo Le Fee, Granit Xhaka, Reinildo and Nordi Mukiele midway through the second period to turn the game.

Mukiele provided a deserved equaliser, crossing for Jules Ahoka, who used the pace on the delivery to guide the ball back from where it came and into the bottom right corner.

Sunderland were denied a late penalty after a VAR check, but their relentless second-half pressure finally paid off in stoppage time. Xhaka touched the ball down for Sadiki in the area and he slammed a shot into the net before jumping into the away end to celebrate with their jubilant supporters.

The key moments from Sunderland's late win

24: SUNDERLAND GOAL RULED OUT! O'Nien's long throw is flicked on and Tuterov nods in unmarked at the back post, but the referee blows for a foul somewhere in the box.

37: GOAL! Volnei scores the goal of his life! The centre-back carries the ball over the halfway line, gets past Angulo and Ahoka before sending a shot into the top right corner from 25 yards.

45: YELLOW! Sunderland have lost their heads over some soft fouls given by the referee, and he books Hume for sarcastically clapping him.

57: BRILLIANT SAVE! Rigg's cross finds the unmarked Angulo, whose header Lucas Paes superbly keeps out.

59: SUBS! Here come Sunderland's heavyweights. Le Fee, Xhaka, Reinildo and Mukiele are on for Fofana, Angulo, Methalie and Hume.

67: GOAL! Sunderland level as Mukiele's cross is headed in by Ahoka.

89: SUNDERLAND DENIED PENALTY! After a VAR check, the referee overturns his decision to award a spot kick for a foul on Tuterov.

90+3: SADIKI WINS IT! Xhaka touches the ball down for the midfielder in the area and he slams a volley into the net.

"I'm really happy for the team because we showed great mentality today. We were down but we came back. That's what we needed to do, and now we focus on the next game.

"They made it really difficult for us, even though people considered us favourites before the game. I'm really happy for them because they showed what it means to play in the Europa League, even though they're in the second division.

"You don't have to be scared of the big teams. So they played really well, but unfortunately for them, we won."

What the result means and next fixtures...

articles.title: Matarazzo: "No sienta bien encajar un gol a balón parado al final cuando vas ganando"
articles.standfirst: El técnico de la Real lamentó no poder llevarse los tres puntos de su visita al USG
articles.summary: El técnico de la Real lamentó no poder llevarse los tres puntos de su visita al USG
articles.body: Pellegrino Matarazzo lamentó que su Real Sociedad no pudiera aguantar hasta el final del partido una victoria que acarició, después de hacer un buen encuentro en líneas generales a su juicio. Matarazzo analizó así el 1-1 final en Lovaina. “Uno no se siente bien cuando juegas un buen partido, vas ganando 0-1 hasta el final del encuentro y terminas encajando un gol a balón parado. No deja una buena sensación, pero esto también es fútbol. Hoy jugamos contra un buen equipo, fue un partido de dos conjuntos que compitieron bien entre sí y en el que hemos visto muchas cosas positivas que podemos llevarnos para las próximas semanas: varios aspectos han mejorado sensiblemente y muchos futbolistas han firmado un gran rendimiento. Estoy contento por eso, aunque desafortunadamente solo nos llevamos un punto”. Su equipo estuvo peor en el primer tiempo que en el segundo. “Son un equipo que encaja muy pocos goles, que saben cómo defender y cómo cerrar los espacios. Aun así, creo que tuvimos momentos en los que encontramos a Oyarzabal por detrás, encontramos profundidad con Job y con Gonçalo en ciertas fases. Sin embargo, no movimos la pelota con suficiente rapidez y a menudo no tomamos la decisión correcta, aunque no creo que fuera una mala primera parte. Nos sentíamos con confianza al descanso y dijimos que teníamos que continuar, jugar con más determinación y encontrar esos espacios”. Matarazzo tuvo claro lo que corregir en el descanso. “La presión. Nos faltó una referencia en la presión alta; ellos nos sorprendieron un poco con la forma en que basculaban con su línea de tres centrales. Esperábamos un movimiento diferente hacia el otro lado y nos llevó demasiado tiempo identificarlo para presionar más arriba. Eso fue lo que corregimos en la segunda parte. Además, el bloque bajo no estaba del todo claro: Luka no estaba bien posicionado, estaba demasiado alto y no formábamos un 1-5-4-1 claro. Por eso modificamos ligeramente la estructura de presión en el segundo tiempo y creo que se sintió mucho mejor”. El de Nueva Jersey insistió en la decepción por no ganar al final. “Sí, es amargo. No siento que ellos hayan tenido una gran cantidad de ocasiones; esa es al menos mi sensación. A veces cometemos errores sencillos, no despejamos con la contundencia suficiente, lo que permite que se inicien ciertas transiciones, aunque siempre estábamos por delante del balón bloqueando disparos. Creo que defendimos bien, incluso en la segunda mitad. Pienso que fue una falta innecesaria de Pablo en ese momento. Dos jugadores van arriba por el balón, nosotros mismos lo peinamos y no retrocedemos con la línea defensiva lo suficientemente rápido, dejando a un jugador completamente solo. Así que esa jugada a balón parado no la defendimos bien, y eso duele”. El técnico realista fue cuestionado por el punto de seis sumado en dos jornadas. “Sí, tenemos la presión de rendir y de ganar, está claro, para alcanzar nuestros objetivos. Sabemos que tenemos un grupo difícil, pero somos ambiciosos con nuestras metas y nos atenemos a ello, y la semana que viene queremos ganar en Oslo”.

articles.title: Bordalás: “Nos faltó acierto en la definición”
articles.standfirst: El técnico azulón analizó el empate en Rumanía en sala de prensa
articles.summary: El técnico azulón analizó el empate en Rumanía en sala de prensa
articles.body: José Bordalás compareció en sala de prensa tras el empate frente al Universitatea Craiova, un punto que no dejó satisfecho al entrenador alicantino, que, pese a ello, señaló que el equipo tuvo personalidad y pudo incluso lograr el triunfo. Valoración: “Necesitábamos empezar a ganar, por eso no estoy satisfecho con el empate. El equipo mostró carácter, pero nos costó jugar de forma directa y nos faltó acierto en la definición”. Rival: “El Craiova no me sorprendió. Sabía que es un equipo que ha crecido en los últimos años, con jugadores talentosos y un ambiente increíble. Sabía que sería un partido difícil”. Gol azulón: “Gudelj ya ha marcado goles así desde lejos anteriormente, y gracias a él logramos el empate”. Gica Craioveanu: “Es una leyenda en España. Jugó en varios clubes y es muy querido en el Getafe. Es una leyenda; todos lo recordamos. Fue un futbolista magnífico y una persona magnífica”.

articles.title: College Football Playoff expanding to 24 teams in 2027, with more games coming to campuses across the country
articles.summary: ESPN is set to finalize a deal Thursday to broadcast the expanded 24-team College Football Playoff, featuring 19 at-large bids and campus games.
articles.body: The College Football Playoff is doubling up. After what will be just three years of having a 12-team CFB Playoff, the field is being expanded to 24 teams beginning in 2027. Signs have long been pointing to an expansion, but now the final piece of the puzzle has all but fallen into place with ESPN reportedly jumping on board; this drastic change to the sport is taking shape in a hurry.
